Add a music folder to get started
Adds missing tracks to same-name USB playlists, but keeps existing USB tracks.
Back up PDB and eDB before export
Before each export, copies the PDB and eDB into a timestamped backups folder alongside the originals.
Each backup holds both of the USB's databases: legacy (PDB) and new (eDB).
Same-name playlists on USB are rewritten to exactly match this app playlist (old tracks removed).
Select tracks to add to a playlist or edit them
The newest backup always stays on the USB; older ones are archived on this computer up to this count, then pruned.

Whenever this app changes a USB, rebuilds the library Denon Prime and Numark Mixstream players read, so they use its beat grids, cues and playlists without importing and analyzing again. Play history is kept; changes made on the player itself (cues, loops, playlists) are replaced.
Where Convert… saves the AIFF, WAV and MP3 files it makes. Keep it outside your music folders, so other music apps don't list the files twice. A new folder only applies to new files.
